lines.text: Many learners say: I am going to the work.
Better: I am going to work.
We say go to work with no the.
To work! She goes to work by bus.

data.wrong: I am going to the work.
data.why: We say go to work with no the.

native.tip: En español “voy al trabajo”, pero en inglés se dice “go to work”, sin “the”: “I am going to work.”
native.caption: Muchos dicen “I am going to the work.” 🙈 En español “voy al trabajo” lleva artículo, pero en inglés se dice “go to work”, sin “the”: “I am going to work.” ¡Escucha a Ama y repite! Practica más en la app Lexkite.
native.comment: Respuesta: “to work”. Se dice “go to work”, sin “the”. Di en voz alta una frase tuya con “go to work”. Practica más con un quiz gratis aquí: {link}

en.tip: In Spanish “voy al trabajo” has an article, but in English we say “go to work” with no “the”: “I am going to work.”
en.caption: Many learners say “I am going to the work.” In Spanish “voy al trabajo” has an article, but in English we say “go to work” with no “the”: “I am going to work.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
